$made = 0; $old = new Base95N(); $weakOld = WeakReference::create($old);

<?php
class Token95B { function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
class Base95B {
    public $label;
    function __construct($label) { $this->label = $label; }
    function stream(&$token) {
        static $counter = 0; $counter = $counter + 1;
        echo 'BODY|', $counter, '|';
        try { yield $counter; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|', $counter, '|'; }
    }
    function __destruct() { echo $this->label, '|'; }
}
function NewToken95B() { global $weakToken; $token = new Token95B(); $weakToken = WeakReference::create($token); return $token; }
function Warn95B($severity, $message) {
    global $source, $warningCount;
    echo 'WARN|'; $warningCount = $warningCount + 1;
    $slot = null; $probe = $source($slot); echo 'PROBE|', $probe->current(), '|';
    unset($probe); return true;
}
$old = new Base95B('OLD'); $weakOld = WeakReference::create($old);
$original = $old->stream(...); $weakOriginal = WeakReference::create($original);
$middle = new Base95B('MID'); $weakMiddle = WeakReference::create($middle);
$source = $original->bindTo($middle); $weakSource = WeakReference::create($source);
unset($original, $old, $middle);
echo 'BOUND|', $weakOriginal->get() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakMiddle->get() instanceof Base95B, '|';
$slot = null; $seed = $source($slot); echo 'SEED|', $seed->current(), '|'; unset($seed);
$warningCount = 0; set_error_handler('Warn95B');
$maker = new Base95B('MAKER'); $weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
echo 'CALL|'; $g = $source->call($maker, NewToken95B());
restore_error_handler(); unset($source, $maker);
echo 'FRESH|', $warningCount === 1, '|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakMiddle->get() === null, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Base95B, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token95B, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current(), '|'; $g->next();
echo 'DONE|', $g->getReturn() === null, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Base95B, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|';
unset($g); echo 'DROP|', $weakMaker->get() === null, '|E';
